prompt.en: I need an interpreter for my talk.

en: Certainly. The interpreter will sit at the back of the room.
Certainly. Our interpreter will sit at the back of the room.
zh: 好的,口译员会坐在会场后排。
好的,我们的口译员会坐在会场的后排。

en: Yes, translation is available in Chinese through headphones.
Yes, translation in Chinese is available through headphones.
zh: 有的,通过耳机提供中文翻译。
有,听众可以通过耳机收听中文翻译。

en: Your presentation lasts thirty minutes, followed by questions.

en: The speaker will arrive at nine. We will meet them at the entrance.
The speaker arrives at nine. We will meet them at the entrance.

发言人九点到,我们会在入口迎接。
